ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) is making a material investment of ₹125 Crores into its subsidiary, Minakshi Agro Industries LLP, primarily to establish a new malt distillery and maturation warehouse, signaling a strategic move into the premium single malt whisky segment. This expansion aims to strengthen ABDL's manufacturing footprint and premium portfolio for long-term growth. However, a portion of the investment includes ₹10 Crores to cover cost overruns on previously approved projects, which, despite justifications, flags potential past budgeting or project management challenges.
